svg.text: A store server can die in the middle of checkout, after the order exists but before the cart points at it. The agent makes cart completion produce exactly one order
across separate server and worker processes, and makes the survivors clean up without waiting for a client.
runs in every process: order, payment
order created, cart not linked yet
no client request: finds the abandoned execution
finish it (one linked order) or undo it (no order, no reservations)
retry on Server B: 200, the same order id
the dead holder's lock delays it at most 15 s
each gets the order, or 409 while completion is in progress
At most one order, one payment authorization and one reservation per stocked line; an unknown payment provider keeps its existing error and creates no order.
a server dies between creating the order and linking the cart
